links.outcome: Radiographers' optimism about AI by prior AI education, hands-on experience, and digital literacy
links.effect: Optimism higher with prior AI education (mean 2.15 vs 1.89; p<0.001) and hands-on AI experience (correlation 0.047; p=0.038).
links.quote: This was particularly strong for those with prior AI education (mean: 2.15 vs. 1.89; p-value: < 0.001), hands-on experience with AI (correlation: 0.047; p-value: 0.038), from countries with higher digital literacy (mean: 2.00 vs.1.93; p-value: 0.027) and a higher academic level of radiography education (mean: 3.28 vs. 3.15; p-value: 0.002).

screen.reason: Empirical survey assessing European radiographers' perceptions, education, and attitudes toward AI implementation in their clinical practice and professional identity.
